ecological_question: Does departure behavior become more contingent on a local temperature cue when that cue has greater pre-existing predictive value for later Bylot conditions?
claim_role: behavioral cue-uptake proxy; not a direct D-to-q theorem test

information_coordinate.primary: route-context predictive connectivity estimated only from climate years preceding each focal migration year
information_coordinate.cue_state: temperature anomaly at the current staging context over its prespecified seasonal window
information_coordinate.primary_detrending: OLS residuals after separate linear regressions of source and target annual window means on calendar year within each 20-year pre-focal training window
information_coordinate.source_arima_boundary: Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024 used ARIMA-model residuals for the published 1979-2018 correlations; that source method is an external calibration/sensitivity, not the focal primary q definition

movement_decision.unit: individual x staging-context x day at risk
movement_decision.departure_definition: first movement leaving the staging context followed by no return for at least 48 h
movement_decision.current_cue: local 3-day mean 2-m temperature anomaly ending on the decision day

context_definition.assignment: habitat centroid must fall in exactly one source-backed stopover polygon

primary_model.formula: depart_next_24h ~ local_temp_anom3 * z_predictive_connectivity + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(context) + C(year)
primary_model.uncertainty: cluster by individual; if supported by software, two-way sensitivity by individual and year
primary_model.directional_prediction: positive on logit departure hazard: warm cues promote departure more strongly where they historically predict later warm/early Bylot conditions

threshold_secondary.role: descriptive threshold-like behavioral uptake, not q_wait(D)
threshold_secondary.support_gate: interior candidate beats no-threshold model and adjacent grid points are not tied within 1 SE
threshold_secondary.one_se_definition: paired held-out-individual log-loss difference: each adjacent candidate must be worse than the selected threshold by more than one SE of the paired fold differences

forbidden_reframings: do not call local temperature sensitivity direct observation of cue cognition
do not treat captivity duration as identified PAYOFF-B D
do not infer q_wait(D) from the GPS model
do not use same-year future Bylot temperature to construct pre-commitment q
do not retune departure definition or q window after outcome inspection
promotion_rule: At most promote to natural behavioral cue-uptake support. Direct information-deadline confirmation remains forbidden without clean D and state-loss estimates.

movement_preprocessing.implementation: movepp R package workflow, fixed before outcome analysis
steps: retain LL and LH for temporary-habitat detection
detect_habitat_params() with data-derived eps and minPts
movement_preprocessing.sensitivity_manual_annotation: allowed only after primary automatic result and without access to climate q or model residuals
movement_preprocessing.departure_event_from_habitat: last day in an automatically delineated spring staging_stopover habitat followed by outward movement and no return for >=48 h
movement_preprocessing.rationale: prevents hand-drawn stopover polygons or climate-informed movement segmentation

input_hygiene.visibility: primary retains only Movebank visible=true GPS fixes
input_hygiene.timestamps: UTC; no temporal resampling or interpolation before movepp
input_hygiene.coordinates: visible=true rows must have finite WGS84 lon/lat in valid ranges; otherwise fail closed
input_hygiene.duplicates: collapse exact duplicates; conflicting same individual_id+timestamp records fail closed

amendment_history.issue: same-day temperature anomaly was listed under immediate_weather_controls but omitted from the literal primary_model formula
amendment_history.resolution: added same_day_temp_anom as an additive control to the registered primary formula

amendment_history.issue: context was named but its cross-individual ecological identity was underspecified; movepp cluster_id is individual-specific and cannot serve as the shared q context
amendment_history.resolution: freeze exactly three shared staging contexts: St_Lawrence, Nunavik, Baffin; Bylot remains target only; require source-backed polygon assignment of automatic staging habitats

amendment_history.issue: environmental data family, anomaly baseline, St. Lawrence primary window, precipitation quantity, and wind-bearing construction were conceptually specified but not operationally frozen
amendment_history.resolution: freeze NARR as primary climate family; trailing 20-year pre-focal climate baselines; St_Lawrence 1-15 May primary and 1 Apr-15 May sensitivity; daily accumulated precipitation; fixed source-region-centroid route bearings

amendment_history.issue: the phrase 'adjacent grid points are not tied within 1 SE' did not specify whether SE was marginal or paired across identical LOIO folds
amendment_history.resolution: freeze paired individual-fold differences (adjacent minus selected); require paired mean difference > one paired SE for both immediate neighbors

amendment_history.issue: movepp package version was not pinned

parent registration required separate detrending but did not specify the temporal model; source paper used ARIMA residuals while PAYOFF-B broad-bird predictive connectivity used deterministic linear detrending
amendment_history.resolution: freeze OLS linear detrending as the focal primary q definition; retain source ARIMA residual correlations as external calibration/sensitivity only

amendment_history.issue: Movebank visible/outlier handling, coordinate validity, duplicate handling, and pre-movepp interpolation were not explicitly frozen
amendment_history.resolution: retain only source-managed visible=true GPS fixes; require valid coordinates; collapse exact duplicates only; fail on conflicting same-individual timestamps; no custom speed filtering, smoothing, interpolation or resampling before movepp
